description:
Left with broken hands by her jealous best friend, Evelyn thought her art career was over until she signed a midnight contract at the mysterious SCP Abyss Gallery. Armed with a single paintbrush, she uncovers rule-based horrors, tames forbidden anomalies, and awakens the legendary "God's Hand" power! Every creature she restores becomes her loyal guardian. As Ancient Gods break their seals and darkness swallows the world, watch her rise from a crippled art student to the supreme ruler of the SCP Foundation. Subscribe now for the ultimate female revenge fantasy! 🌟✨
